title: Any OpenAI-compatible API (LLM)
description: Any API that speaks OpenAI's chat completions, as an LLM tier: give its address and key.
setup_notes: Use the address its documentation gives for OpenAI-compatible clients (it ends in /v1 for most). A server on this machine or network with no key is set up directly under Admin > LLMs as llama.cpp or vLLM instead. Choose it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM), where the tier names its model and the key can be changed; Test connection there makes one short real chat. The tier's turns run on it through gohort's own OpenAI-style client, streaming and tool calls as usual, and the key stays with the connection. Its calls and their cost show on the connector's row; add per_million_input and per_million_output to its spec's cost to price its tokens, which then replace the tier's rates under Costs. It has no default model: the tier names the one to run.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the LLM settings list it by this name.

config.name: base_url
config.label: API address
config.help: The address the API's /chat/completions and /models are under, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1.

config.name: api_key
config.label: API key
config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
